title: OpenToonz: free Toon Boom alternative
caption:
Toon Boom Harmony charges $31/month to animate your own cartoons. OpenToonz does it for free 🎬

✅ Draw your frames and recolor everything from one palette
✅ Scan pencil drawings in and clean them up
✅ Timeline, xsheet and a node tree for effects
✅ Based on the software Studio Ghibli customized for its films
✅ No subscription, no watermark, no account

💻 Windows · Mac
ℹ️ Heads up: it's a pro-style animation tool with a lot of panels, so expect a learning curve, and there's no ready-made Linux installer

Comment "CARTOON" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
